L4: ## The education you seek made more affordable.
L5: 
L6: Finding the time and money to go back to school while still working is a challenge. But thanks to your employer partnering with UMass Global, you can get the degree or certificate you seek, upgrading your skills and improving your career outlook. And you can do so at significant savings. Plus, our online coursework fits into the busiest of lives!
L7: ### Your Discounts at a Glance
L8: 
L9: Because your employer is a Premier Partner with UMass Global, these are the scholarships available to employees and their spouses and dependents:
L10: 
L11: 20% Scholarship
L12: 
L13:   * Master of Arts in Educational Leadership and Administration
L14:   * Organizational Custom Off-site Cohorts (as approved by the University)
L15: 
L16: 15% Scholarship
L17:   * Master of Arts in Teaching
L18:   * Teaching Credentials (Single Subject, Multiple Subject, and Special Education)
L19:   * Master of Arts in Marriage and Family Therapy
L20: 
L21: 10% Scholarship
L22: 
L23:   * Certificates (grad and undergrad)
L24:   * Associate degrees
L25:   * Bachelor's degrees
L26:   * Master's degrees (except as specifically noted)
L27:   * Doctoral degrees (Ed.D. and DSW)
L28:   * UMass Global MyPath programs

L721: ## Get started in 6 simple steps
L722:   1. Speak with an Enrollment Coach — Call 800.746.0082 or fill out a 【38†request for information form】.
L723:   2. Complete your application, it’s free and easy! — 【35†Click here to apply!】
L724:   3. Receive your acceptance letter — Congratulations 🎉 !
L725:   4. Complete the scholarship verification form — 【39†Click here to fill out the form and submit your verification.】
L726:   5. Get financially cleared — Make an appointment with our helpful OneStop Specialists.
L727:   6. Enroll in classes — Work with an assigned Academic Advisor to come up with a schedule that works for you.
